g.text: orange band: its corridor, ± 10 % of the length
(300 m – 1.5 km), blocked for the next search
dashed circles: kept open (1.5 × band) near start,
landing and waypoints, which every route must reach
Side = sign of the average signed offset of
the route from the straight line; "along the
straight line" when below max(150 m, 3 %).
